en: A black‑and‑white riverside view showing a large paddle steamer with the word "DRESDEN" visible on its side, moving along a broad river. In the foreground are moored wooden boats. On the opposite bank rises a historic town with dense masonry buildings, church towers, and a large hilltop complex resembling a castle or palace. Smoke from the steamer's funnels drifts across the scene, and there is a bridge just behind the vessel. The overall look is that of an early 20th‑century European city postcard.
